methods.name: init
methods.desc:
Initialise the period. Called as an inner ARC-4 call from the registry's createPeriod.
Can only be called once (registryApp must still be 0); creator (the registry app account)
is the only allowed sender.

methods.name: removeTopic
methods.desc: Remove the topic at $topicIndex. Operator only; only allowed while editable.

methods.name: setReady
methods.desc: Set the ready flag. Once ready=true, edits are blocked and voting becomes possible. Operator only.

methods.name: canVote
methods.desc: Whether an account can vote and the resulting voting power. Returns [false, 0] in any rejection case.

methods.name: logPeriod
methods.desc:
Log the full period across many log lines instead of one ARC-4 return value.
getPeriod() returns the whole period as a single logged value, which overflows the
1024-byte per-call ABI return limit once the topics get large (~22 Yes/No/Abstain topics).
logPeriod logs the header (GGovPeriodMeta) first, then one GGovTopic per line, so a
reader simulating with allowMoreLogging can reconstruct an arbitrarily large period.

methods.name: logVotingRecord
methods.desc:
Log a full vote record across many log lines instead of one ARC-4 return value.
getVotingRecord() returns the whole record as a single logged value, which overflows the
1024-byte per-call ABI return limit once topicVotes gets large (same failure mode as
getPeriod/logPeriod). logVotingRecord logs the header (GGovVoteRecordMeta) first, then one
topic's votes (GGovTopicVotes) per line, so a reader simulating with allowMoreLogging can
reconstruct an arbitrarily large record. No logs at all means no record exists.

methods.name: increaseBudget

args.name: itxns
args.desc: Number of no-op itxns to perform

methods.desc: Utility to increase opcode budget by performing $itxns no-op itxns

periodId.desc: This period's ID on the registry

ready.desc: Operator-set ready flag. Period must be ready=true to accept votes; cannot be edited while ready.

committeeId.desc: Committee ID this period votes against (lives in registry)

topicOptionsArr.desc: Per-topic option labels. Mutated only while editable. Parallel to topicVotesArr (same length & order).

topicVotesArr.desc: Per-topic vote tallies. Mutated on every vote(). Parallel to topicOptionsArr (same length & order).

voteRecords.desc: Per-voter vote record, keyed by voter Account
